chants.vernacular_text: The Lord said unto me: You are my Son, today I have begotten you. ℣. Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?

Sovereign strength is yours on the day of your great might. Amidst the splendours of the heavenly sanctuary, from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten you. ℣. The Lord said unto my Lord: "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies a stool for your feet."
The Lord said unto me: "You are my Son, today I have begotten you."
Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad before the face of the Lord for he cometh.
Amidst the splendours of the heavenly sanctuary, from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten you.
